scripts.dev: bun run db:migrate && bun run build:client && bun server/src/index.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun x tsc --noEmit -p client/tsconfig.json && bun x tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.json && bun x tsc --noEmit -p server/tsconfig.worker.json
scripts.dev:cf: bun run build:client && bun x wrangler dev
scripts.deploy:cf: bun run build:client && bun x wrangler deploy
scripts.db:create:cf: bun x wrangler d1 create barber-db
scripts.db:migrate:cf:local: bun x wrangler d1 migrations apply barber-db --local
scripts.db:migrate:cf: bun x wrangler d1 migrations apply barber-db --remote
